title: CIA implants a chip in Lynn Kyle's skull, the origin of the tinfoil hat

tellings.quote: and unfortunately his his psychologist was worked for the CIA and they put a chip in his skull without telling him

plain: A man named Lynn Kyle is said to have had a chip put in his skull without his knowledge by his psychologist, who worked for the CIA, the American spy agency, and this is offered as the origin of the tinfoil hat. The comedian Kurt Metzger tells it, passing on the story from Kyle and from a man named Carlos Delgado. If true, it would mean the agency secretly implanted devices in people.
